Kosher pickles recipe without vinegar: you will need 1-2 garlick cloves, 1 sprig of dill, a pinch of crush red pepper, 6-8 small cucumbers, roughly 2 1/2 cups of brine, and a grape leaf to maintain crispness. To make the brine you want to put 1 tbs of kosher salt per cup of water or 2 1/2 tsp of pickling salt per cup. Put all this in a sterilized quart mason jar and let it ferment for 7 to 10 day in a dark area at room temperature. Open the lid once a day to let out the gas. This recipe utilizes lacto fermentaion to preserve and pickle the cucumbers.
